claims.head: Good looks against hopeful ones
claims.body: On shot quality, Montréal is the league’s best and Nashville is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Canadiens and the Predators sit at opposite ends for shot quality.
claims.call: The Canadiens’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Predators’.

MTL.head: Montréal has a slight edge
MTL.body: Montréal has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Nashville can still swing it if their power play gets going.

NSH.head: A slightly uphill night for Nashville
NSH.body: Montréal has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Nashville’s best way to tip it is a power play that gets going.
